notes: This submission is not affiliated with Xiaomi. We use Xiaomi's real, open-weight (Apache 2.0) Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365 checkpoint as a frozen base -- backbone entirely unmodified, verified via exact DiT weight-sum match before/after every training run -- and fine-tune it with rank-4 LoRA adapters on the VLM's language_model attention/MLP layers, plus our own sparse end-to-end memory core (Hopfield network + HGRN gate + adaptive gate) applied to pooled VLM hidden states as an additive consolidation-loss regularizer. Trained on real RoboCasa365 data (NVIDIA PhysicalAI-Robotics-Manipulation-Kitchen-Demos), restricted to the 34 official atomic_seen+composite_seen tasks (composite_unseen correctly held out of training). Results are from a completed, official 50-task/2500-episode target50 eval run (2500/2500 episodes, 0 errors). For reference, the frozen base checkpoint alone scores atomic_seen=79.44, composite_seen=57.63, composite_unseen=30.75 on this same protocol -- this submission is essentially tied with baseline on atomic_seen and modestly behind on composite_seen/composite_unseen in this run. code_url/checkpoint_url are being migrated to a public GitHub repo and Hugging Face checkpoint under our own account and will be updated here shortly; private access for verification will be granted to sepnasiriany once that migration completes.
